landing.title: Manage your freelance business, hassle-free
landing.subtitle: Salair automates your invoices, payments and tax declarations. For freelancers who want to focus on their work, not on administrative tasks.

features.title: Features
features.heading: An all-in-one tool, designed for freelancers
features.description: Salair structures your freelance activity from your first client. No more Excel files and forgotten tax reminders.

access.title: Manage your clients easily
access.description: Create complete client profiles, view their invoice history and track your relationships effortlessly.

payslips.title: Create invoices in 30 seconds
payslips.description: Generate and send professional compliant invoices, ready to be paid online.

reports.title: Track your payments and income
reports.description: Get paid by transfer or card, automatically remind unpaid invoices, and track your revenue throughout the month.

employees.title: Prepare your tax declarations
employees.description: Salair reminds you of your deadlines and guides you step by step through your monthly or quarterly declarations.

documents.title: Centralize your tax documents
documents.description: Invoices, receipts, statements: everything is organized, archived and ready for audits or accounting.

support.title: Responsive human support
support.description: Have a question about your declarations or invoices? We'll support you from A to Z, without unnecessary jargon.
